name: Greater Mark Of Warding
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Warding Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Improved Intuition
features.description: When you use the Warder’s Intuition benefit of your Mark of Warding feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

features.name: Improved Warding
features.description: When a creature makes an attack roll against you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
